scope: Audio timing logic tests against production IntercomFootstepClock source
checks: Two contact boundaries per cycle, loop-safe
Stopped, collision-blocked and airborne gates reset cadence
No accumulated steps after a stall
Animator state switch and rewinds reset cadence
Pause and respawn reset suppress delayed steps
Frozen animation does not repeat steps
limitations: Unity Editor was not available; actual audio playback and AudioSource lifecycle require a Play Mode/device check.
Forward authored foot contacts approximate phase0/.5; directional blends are not foot IK and the profile exposes phase offset.
